body.statement: In Definition \(\mathrm{def:primary\text{-}morse\text{-}instance}\), \(\theta_0,\theta_h\in\mathcal M^{\mathrm{Morse}}_{2,2,1}\), \(\beta_1=\beta_2=\mathrm{id}\), \(\det D\Psi_h=1\), and \(\lVert\Psi_h-\mathrm{id}\rVert_\infty=O(h^2)\), \(\lVert D(\Psi_h-\mathrm{id})\rVert_\infty=O(h)\), and \(\lVert D^2(\Psi_h-\mathrm{id})\rVert_\infty=O(1)\), with the same bounds for the inverse. The observational and two baseline contributions are exactly zero: \(H^2(P_{\theta_0}^{\mathrm{obs}},P_{\theta_h}^{\mathrm{obs}})=H^2(P_{\theta_0}^{1,0},P_{\theta_h}^{1,0})=H^2(P_{\theta_0}^{2,0},P_{\theta_h}^{2,0})=0\). For \(i=1,2\), \[h^{-8}H^2(P_{\theta_0}^{i,1},P_{\theta_h}^{i,1})\longrightarrow c_i:=\frac{b_i^2q_i^1(0)\tau^2}{8(2\pi)^2}\int_{|\xi|<1}\xi_i^2\eta(|\xi|^2)^2(J_2\xi)_i^2d\xi>0.\] Since \(b_1\ne b_2\), a wrong group permutation has a fixed positive limiting cost, and therefore \(D_H(\theta_0,\theta_h)=C_Hh^4\{1+o(1)\}\), where \(C_H^2=c_1+c_2\). The synthetic products satisfy \(B_{\theta_0}=B_{\theta_h}=1\), so the synthetic-law Hellinger residual and \(\lVert|\det D\Psi_h|-1\rVert_{L^2(\lambda^2)}\) are zero. Writing \(\overline p_0(0)=\{3+q_1^1(0)+q_2^1(0)\}/5\), parity gives zero transverse conditional mean for \(\eta(|\xi|^2)J_2\xi\). Conditional variance, even after enlarging the quotient to all measurable coordinate functions, gives the same positive leading coefficient for both directed losses because \(d\bar P_{\theta_h}/d\bar P_{\theta_0}=1+O(h^2)\) on the packet: \[\liminf_{h\downarrow0}h^{-6}d_{\mathrm{rep}}(\theta_0,\theta_h)^2\ge\frac{\overline p_0(0)\tau^2}{(2\pi)^2}\sum_{i=1}^2\int_{|\xi|<1}\eta(|\xi|^2)^2(J_2\xi)_i^2d\xi>0.\] Every wrong coordinate permutation has fixed positive loss at \(h=0\), and the identity coordinate gauge gives the matching upper order. Hence the symmetric quotient pseudometric satisfies \(d_{\mathrm{rep}}(\theta_0,\theta_h)\asymp h^3\), while the complete-law distance is order \(h^4\), yielding the audited power \(3/4\).
body.justification: The complete \(n=2\), \(C^2\), Morse calculation makes the \(3/4\) lower order auditable environment by environment and through the nonlinear quotient.
body.gap: CauCA's determinant-one plateau rotation has zero law error; this instance computes the nonzero Hellinger coefficient at isolated Morse points and the surviving quotient coefficient.
body.consumer: The calculation is the unit test for any proof, implementation, or claimed improvement of the primary recovery exponent.
